title: Labeling Harness
description: Human-in-the-loop workbench that turns raw recordings into a verified speech dataset. Three recognizers draft every clip, disagreement pushes the doubtful ones to the top of a ranked queue, and one annotator checks them at keyboard speed — 61 hours and 17,000+ Nepali–English clips labeled so far.

title: Linite
description: Bulk installer for 200+ curated Linux apps across 14 distros and 11 package managers, from APT to Flatpak. Supports shareable collections, cross-device install tracking, and daily metadata sync from Flathub, Snapcraft, AUR, and Repology.

title: InfraWise
description: Models cloud vs. on-prem total cost of ownership across 8 cost categories, with multi-year projections, breakeven, and sensitivity analysis over 80+ variables.
